body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. The target cannot gain Defense from equipment against your next Prowess Action this turn.

surges.html: On a success, the target burns 1 die from its available pool.
Deal +1 weapon damage; you suffer -1 Defense until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: BREAKER
rider.html: If this Action succeeds, you may spend 1 Combo to knock the target Prone.
